proposed_english: You will go there without me.

note: de qui je veux parler means 'who I want to talk about', not merely 'who I mean'.
proposed_target: Vous savez de qui je veux parler.
proposed_english: You know who I want to talk about.

traiter d'idiot means 'call me an idiot', not adjective 'call me stupid'.

note: dès que means 'as soon as', stronger than generic 'when'.
